verdict_rule_text.ALIVE: rho_hon CI within [-0.15, 0.15], rho_pc CI lo >= 0.30, RR >= 0.10, and the call-level honest flag rate at the A bounds <= 0.02 with CI hi <= 0.05
verdict_rule_text.WEAK: rho_hon point within [-0.15, 0.15] and rho_pc CI lo > rho_hon CI hi, but an ALIVE condition fails (label names which, e.g. 'coverage' when RR < 0.10)
verdict_rule_text.DEAD: rho_hon point > 0.15 (honest residual already scales with output size) or rho_pc CI lo <= rho_hon CI hi
verdict_rule_text.threshold_reason: judgment calls fixed now: |rho| <= 0.15 is 'uncorrelated' at the n expected; 0.30 is the smallest positive-control dependence worth a detector; 0.10 coverage is the share below which a shell check covers too little of the corpus to matter.

deviations.what_you_did: followed the pre-registration: analysis/probes/phase_e_n1.py -> analysis/out/phase_e/n1.json (the orchestrator's template would have given phase_e_n1_duration.py / n1_duration.json)
deviations.why: the pre-registration is the output contract

deviations.item: positive-control instance when the drawn instance has no same-status reference
deviations.prereg_said: in each group one instance (rng_for('N1pc', session, key)) gets delta' = T_gen; rho_pc over the tampered instances, each against its group's untouched instances
deviations.what_you_did: the instance is drawn uniformly (rng_for('N1pc', session_id, n1_key)) among the group's instances that have >= 1 other instance with the same primary-error status, i.e. among those n1_residuals() gives a residual; 'key' is read as the n1_key string, which names the group within a session
deviations.why: the residual rule (same error status) leaves an instance without a reference undefined; drawing among undefined instances would silently drop groups
deviations.effect_on_verdict: none by construction of the rule; every repeat group with >= 1 residual contributes one tampered instance

deviations.what_you_did: a tampered instance with 0 result chars has delta' = 0 and log10 undefined; it is dropped from rho_pc (prereg_e_common.spearman drops non-finite values) and counted in positive_control.dropped_zero_char_results

deviations.prereg_said: ALIVE / WEAK / DEAD rules of S:n1_conditional_duration.verdict
deviations.what_you_did: INCONCLUSIVE when rho_hon point < -0.15 without a DEAD condition (no rule covers it), or when a CI the rule needs has < 900 valid bootstrap draws; INSUFFICIENT_N below the min n; rule order DEAD, ALIVE, WEAK
deviations.why: the three rules do not partition the space
deviations.effect_on_verdict: none: no block hit INCONCLUSIVE (see results)

deviations.item: which scope carries the unit verdict
deviations.prereg_said: scope: shell family primary, auto_read secondary; detector bounds pooled over the unit's scope
deviations.what_you_did: the N6 cell uses the primary (shell) verdict; auto_read gets its own verdict, reported as secondary; artifact checks and strata run on the primary scope
deviations.why: the verdict text does not say which scope it is applied to

deviations.prereg_said: N6 fill rule: the cell is the E verdict where E exists and is not INSUFFICIENT_N, else the B verdict 'B only'; artifact checks run on B u E for any N cell at WEAK or better
deviations.what_you_did: B, E and B u E are all computed and reported; the cell follows the N6 rule. Where only the B u E pooled re-measurement reached WEAK (codex, gemini), AC2-AC5 and the strata were also run on it for information and AC1 was NOT_RUN; the pooled label is not the cell
deviations.why: the pooled population is the pre-registered artifact-check population; reporting it is informative and cannot raise a cell

deviations.prereg_said: audit_sample() draws 30 numerator (or flagged) events with SEED_E; FAIL at >= 2 of 30 differing
deviations.what_you_did: the 30 events are detector-flagged primary-scope calls (the N1 numerator), sorted by (session_id, seq), seed_parts ('N1', 'AC1', 'flagged', unit); fewer than 30 flagged -> all audited. A second sample of 30 residual-bearing instances is a diagnostic only. Compared: both stamps (delta within 1 ms), result bytes, primary error flag, n1 command key, raw occurrence count. AC1 FAIL is applied as a one-level downgrade
deviations.why: the prereg does not name N1's numerator or AC1's label effect

deviations.prereg_said: dominance over the denominator events; aiv_cc is one agent, so it is always dominated, and that is only labelled
deviations.what_you_did: denominator events = residuals per session (primary scope); leave-outs recompute every quantity on all sessions outside the left-out cluster; aiv_cc single-cluster kinds (agent, model) are labelled only, its session dominance is tested; missing swechat user_id forms one cluster ('nan', prereg_e_common.session_cluster_map behaviour)
deviations.effect_on_verdict: aiv_cc: without the label-only reading a leave-out of its only agent leaves no data and would cap it at WEAK

deviations.what_you_did: rho_hon and rho_pc as a weighted Spearman (weighted mid-ranks, weighted Pearson) with a session bootstrap; RR and flag rate with prereg_e_common.weighted_cluster_rate. Weights per statistic: post_strat_weights over the residual-bearing sessions for rho and the flag rate, over every session with qualified primary-scope calls for RR
